steps.sql: SELECT BINARY_CHECKSUM(256) AS c0, BINARY_CHECKSUM(-1) AS c1, BINARY_CHECKSUM(CAST(256 AS bigint)) AS c2, BINARY_CHECKSUM(CAST(256 AS smallint)) AS c3, BINARY_CHECKSUM(CAST(2 AS tinyint)) AS c4
SELECT BINARY_CHECKSUM(N'é') AS c0, BINARY_CHECKSUM(N'雪') AS c1, BINARY_CHECKSUM('é') AS c2, BINARY_CHECKSUM(CAST('ab' AS char(4))) AS c3, BINARY_CHECKSUM(N'a', N'b') AS c4
SELECT CHECKSUM(256) AS c0, CHECKSUM(-1) AS c1, CHECKSUM(CAST(256 AS bigint)) AS c2, CHECKSUM(CAST(-1 AS bigint)) AS c3, CHECKSUM(CAST(4294967296 AS bigint)) AS c4
SELECT CHECKSUM(1, NULL) AS c0, CHECKSUM(CAST(NULL AS int)) AS c1, CHECKSUM(CAST(1 AS tinyint), CAST(2 AS smallint)) AS c2

SELECT DATALENGTH(CAST(12345678901 AS decimal(20,0))) AS c0, DATALENGTH(CAST(1 AS decimal(38,0))) AS c1, DATALENGTH(CAST(1 AS numeric(10,0))) AS c2, DATALENGTH(CAST(12345678901234567890123 AS decimal(30,0))) AS c3

SELECT DATALENGTH(CAST('10:00' AS time(0))) AS c0, DATALENGTH(CAST('10:00' AS time(4))) AS c1, DATALENGTH(CAST('2024-01-01' AS datetimeoffset(0))) AS c2, DATALENGTH(CAST('2024-01-01' AS smalldatetime)) AS c3, DATALENGTH(CAST(1 AS smallmoney)) AS c4
SELECT SOUNDEX('a1b') AS c0, SOUNDEX('ab-c') AS c1, SOUNDEX('Ab cd') AS c2, SOUNDEX('ébc') AS c3, SOUNDEX('O''Brien') AS c4
SELECT SOUNDEX('Lloyd') AS c0, SOUNDEX('Jackson') AS c1, SOUNDEX('Washington') AS c2, SOUNDEX('Lee') AS c3, SOUNDEX('Bbbb') AS c4
SELECT SOUNDEX('Smith') AS c0, SOUNDEX('Smyth') AS c1, DIFFERENCE('Smith', 'Smyth') AS c2, DIFFERENCE('Smyth', 'Smith') AS c3
SELECT SOUNDEX('Smith') AS c0, SOUNDEX('Jones') AS c1, DIFFERENCE('Smith', 'Jones') AS c2, DIFFERENCE('Jones', 'Smith') AS c3
SELECT SOUNDEX('Robert') AS c0, SOUNDEX('Rob') AS c1, DIFFERENCE('Robert', 'Rob') AS c2, DIFFERENCE('Rob', 'Robert') AS c3
SELECT SOUNDEX('abc') AS c0, SOUNDEX('abd') AS c1, DIFFERENCE('abc', 'abd') AS c2, DIFFERENCE('abd', 'abc') AS c3
SELECT SOUNDEX('Lee') AS c0, SOUNDEX('Leigh') AS c1, DIFFERENCE('Lee', 'Leigh') AS c2, DIFFERENCE('Leigh', 'Lee') AS c3
SELECT SOUNDEX('Washington') AS c0, SOUNDEX('Washer') AS c1, DIFFERENCE('Washington', 'Washer') AS c2, DIFFERENCE('Washer', 'Washington') AS c3
SELECT SOUNDEX('Jackson') AS c0, SOUNDEX('Jaxen') AS c1, DIFFERENCE('Jackson', 'Jaxen') AS c2, DIFFERENCE('Jaxen', 'Jackson') AS c3
SELECT SOUNDEX('a') AS c0, SOUNDEX('b') AS c1, DIFFERENCE('a', 'b') AS c2, DIFFERENCE('b', 'a') AS c3
SELECT SOUNDEX('Tymczak') AS c0, SOUNDEX('Tinsdale') AS c1, DIFFERENCE('Tymczak', 'Tinsdale') AS c2, DIFFERENCE('Tinsdale', 'Tymczak') AS c3
SELECT SOUNDEX('Ashcraft') AS c0, SOUNDEX('Ashcroft') AS c1, DIFFERENCE('Ashcraft', 'Ashcroft') AS c2, DIFFERENCE('Ashcroft', 'Ashcraft') AS c3
SELECT SOUNDEX('Pfister') AS c0, SOUNDEX('Fister') AS c1, DIFFERENCE('Pfister', 'Fister') AS c2, DIFFERENCE('Fister', 'Pfister') AS c3
SELECT SOUNDEX('Honeyman') AS c0, SOUNDEX('Moneyman') AS c1, DIFFERENCE('Honeyman', 'Moneyman') AS c2, DIFFERENCE('Moneyman', 'Honeyman') AS c3
SELECT FORMAT(-1234.5, 'C') AS c0, FORMAT(-5, 'C0') AS c1
SELECT FORMAT(1234.5678, 'F') AS c0, FORMAT(-0.5, 'N0') AS c1, FORMAT(0.125, 'N2') AS c2, FORMAT(2.5, 'N0') AS c3, FORMAT(CAST(2.5 AS float), 'N0') AS c4
SELECT FORMAT(CAST(0.1 AS float), 'N20') AS c0, FORMAT(1e20, 'N0') AS c1, FORMAT(CAST(1.5 AS real), 'N2') AS c2, FORMAT(-0.001, 'P1') AS c3
SELECT FORMAT(CAST(-1 AS int), 'X') AS c0, FORMAT(CAST(-1 AS smallint), 'X') AS c1, FORMAT(CAST(-1 AS bigint), 'x') AS c2, FORMAT(1.5, 'X') AS c3, FORMAT(1.5, 'D') AS c4
SELECT FORMAT(1234567.891, '#,0.0') AS c0, FORMAT(0, '#') AS c1, FORMAT(0, '0.00') AS c2, FORMAT(-0.004, '0.00') AS c3, FORMAT(42, '00000') AS c4

SELECT FORMAT(CAST('2024-01-31 13:45:30.1234567' AS datetime2), 'yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.fffffff') AS c0, FORMAT(CAST('2024-01-31 13:45:30' AS datetime2), 'MMM d yyyy h:mm tt') AS c1, FORMAT(CAST('2024-03-05' AS date), 'M/d/yy') AS c2

SELECT FORMAT(CAST('2024-01-31 13:45:30' AS datetime2), 'G') AS c0, FORMAT(CAST('2024-01-31 13:45:30' AS datetime2), 'g') AS c1, FORMAT(CAST('2024-01-31 13:45:30' AS datetime2), 't') AS c2, FORMAT(CAST('2024-01-31 13:45:30' AS datetime2), 'T') AS c3

SELECT FORMAT(CAST('2024-01-31 13:45:30' AS datetime2), 's') AS c0, FORMAT(CAST('2024-01-31 13:45:30' AS datetime2), 'M') AS c1, FORMAT(CAST('2024-01-31 13:45:30' AS datetime2), 'Y') AS c2, FORMAT(CAST('2024-01-31 13:45:30 +05:30' AS datetimeoffset), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm zzz') AS c3
SELECT FORMAT(CAST('13:45:30.123' AS time), 'hh\:mm\:ss\.fff') AS c0, FORMAT(CAST('13:45:30' AS time), 'hh:mm') AS c1, FORMAT(CAST('13:45:30' AS time), 'c') AS c2
SELECT ISNUMERIC('1,000.5e3') AS c0, ISNUMERIC('- 5') AS c1, ISNUMERIC('5-') AS c2, ISNUMERIC('$1,2,3') AS c3, ISNUMERIC('1e+') AS c4, ISNUMERIC('.e1') AS c5
SELECT ISNUMERIC('¥5') AS c0, ISNUMERIC('5$') AS c1, ISNUMERIC('$$5') AS c2, ISNUMERIC('+-5') AS c3, ISNUMERIC('1.') AS c4, ISNUMERIC('1 2') AS c5
SELECT DATEADD(day, 1, CAST('2079-06-06 10:00' AS smalldatetime)) AS c0
SELECT DATEADD(minute, -1, CAST('1900-01-01 00:00' AS smalldatetime)) AS c0
SELECT DATEADD(day, 1, CAST('9999-12-31 10:00 +00:00' AS datetimeoffset)) AS c0
SELECT DATEADD(hour, 10, CAST('9999-12-31 20:00 -05:00' AS datetimeoffset)) AS c0
SELECT DATEADD(year, -1, CAST('0001-06-01 10:00' AS datetime2)) AS c0
SELECT DATEADD(day, -1, CAST('1753-01-01' AS datetime)) AS c0

SELECT DATEADD(millisecond, 5, CAST('2024-01-01 00:00:00.000' AS datetime)) AS c0, DATEADD(millisecond, -1, CAST('2024-01-01 00:00:00.000' AS datetime)) AS c1, DATEADD(millisecond, -2, CAST('2024-01-01 00:00:00.000' AS datetime)) AS c2, DATEADD(second, -1, CAST('2024-01-01 00:00:10' AS smalldatetime)) AS c3
SELECT DATETRUNC(second, CAST('2024-01-31 13:45:00' AS smalldatetime)) AS c0, DATETRUNC(minute, CAST('2024-01-31 13:45:00' AS smalldatetime)) AS c1
SELECT DATETRUNC(millisecond, CAST('2024-01-31 13:45:30.12' AS datetime2(2))) AS c0
SELECT DATETRUNC(weekday, CAST('2024-01-31' AS datetime)) AS c0
SELECT DATETRUNC(day, '2024-01-31 13:45:30 +05:00') AS c0, DATETRUNC(day, 45000) AS c1
DECLARE @n int = -1; SELECT LEFT('abc', @n) AS c0
DECLARE @n int = -1; SELECT SUBSTRING('abc', 1, @n) AS c0
DECLARE @n int = -1; SELECT RIGHT(N'abc', @n) AS c0
DECLARE @s varchar(10) = 'abcdef', @i int = 2, @j int = 3; SELECT STUFF(@s, @i, @j, 'XY') AS c0, STUFF(@s, 2, @j, 'XY') AS c1
DECLARE @s nvarchar(10) = N'abcdef'; SELECT REPLICATE(@s, 1000) AS c0, SPACE(LEN(@s)) AS c1, LEFT(@s, LEN(@s) - 1) AS c2
DECLARE @d datetime2(3) = '2024-01-31 10:00:00.123'; SELECT DATEADD(day, 1, @d) AS c0, DATEPART(ms, @d) AS c1, EOMONTH(@d) AS c2, DATETRUNC(hour, @d) AS c3
DECLARE @x decimal(10,4) = 123.4567; SELECT ROUND(@x, 2) AS c0, ROUND(@x, -1, 1) AS c1, CEILING(@x) AS c2, FLOOR(-@x) AS c3, ABS(-@x) AS c4, SIGN(@x) AS c5
DECLARE @f float = 2.5; SELECT ROUND(@f, 0) AS c0, POWER(@f, 2) AS c1, SQRT(@f) AS c2, LOG(@f) AS c3, EXP(@f) AS c4
SELECT TRANSLATE(N'abc', 'ab', N'xy') AS c0, TRANSLATE('abc', N'ab', 'xy') AS c1, TRANSLATE(N'🦆a', N'🦆', N'xy') AS c2
SELECT QUOTENAME(N'a]b', ']') AS c0, QUOTENAME('', '[') AS c1, QUOTENAME('a', '''''') AS c2, QUOTENAME('a', '"') AS c3
SELECT CHARINDEX('a', 'abc', 0) AS c0, CHARINDEX('bc', 'abcbc', 3) AS c1, CHARINDEX(N'é', N'cafe' + NCHAR(769)) AS c2, CHARINDEX('ss', 'straße') AS c3
SELECT REPLACE(N'straße', 'ss', 'X') AS c0, REPLACE('aAa', 'a', 'b') AS c1, REPLACE('abc' COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN2, 'B', 'x') AS c2
SELECT PATINDEX('%[b]%', 'ABC') AS c0, PATINDEX('%b%' COLLATE Latin1_General_CS_AS, 'ABC') AS c1, PATINDEX('a%', 'abc  ') AS c2, PATINDEX('%c', 'abc  ') AS c3
SELECT GREATEST(N'a', 'b' COLLATE Latin1_General_CS_AS) AS c0, LEAST('A', 'a') AS c1, GREATEST('a ', 'a') AS c2
SELECT GREATEST(CAST(1 AS tinyint), CAST(2 AS int)) AS c0, LEAST(CAST(1 AS bigint), CAST(2 AS int)) AS c1, GREATEST(1.5, 2) AS c2, GREATEST(CAST(1 AS float), 2) AS c3
SELECT CHOOSE(3, 'a', 'b', 'c') AS c0, CHOOSE(-1, 'a') AS c1, CHOOSE(1, N'x', 'y') AS c2, CHOOSE(2, 1, 2.5) AS c3
SELECT RAND(3) AS c0; SELECT RAND() AS c0; SELECT RAND(3) AS c0, RAND() AS c1
SELECT RAND(-2147483648) AS c0
SELECT COS(0.5) AS c0, SIN(0.5) AS c1, TAN(0.5) AS c2, ATAN(0.5) AS c3, EXP(0.5) AS c4, LOG(0.5) AS c5, LOG10(0.5) AS c6, SQRT(0.5) AS c7
SELECT COS(2) AS c0, SIN(2) AS c1, TAN(2) AS c2, ACOS(0.1) AS c3, ASIN(0.1) AS c4, EXP(2) AS c5, LOG(2) AS c6, POWER(2.0e0, 0.1) AS c7
